description: Negative zero serialises as 0: ECMA-262 Number::toString maps -0 to the string 0, confirmed by RFC 8785 erratum 7920 (verified 2026-09-11). A producer that emits -0 breaks byte-identity against every conforming producer.
note: added 2026-09-16 at rc.3 (DS-3); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
